modelMap.title: Model mapping
modelMap.desc: Inbound model names are rewritten to Qwen models before requests reach upstream; names not listed fall back to the default row.
modelMap.rulesHint: On save, aliases are lowercased and trailing [..] suffixes removed. An alias equal to a Qwen model id overrides that id — this is intentional.
modelMap.clusterHint: With multiple replicas, a persisted mapping only takes effect on the other replicas after they restart.
modelMap.noneModeHint: DATA_SAVE_MODE=none: changes only live in memory and are lost on restart.
modelMap.noRows: No mappings yet — click “Add row” to start.
modelMap.unassignedHint: Names that fell back since the last restart. Click one to add a row for it.
modelMap.noTargets: Upstream model list unavailable: no Qwen model to choose. Check the accounts and reload.
modelMap.loadFailed: Failed to load settings; the mapping shown may be stale.
modelMap.confirmReset: Discard the mapping saved from the dashboard and restore MODEL_MAP from the environment?

apiKey.title: API keys
apiKey.desc: The admin key is read-only; regular keys authenticate client requests and can be added or removed at any time.
apiKey.addHint: Use a long random string; the key takes effect immediately.
apiKey.confirmDelete: Clients using this key will lose access immediately. Delete it?

autoRefresh.title: Auto refresh
autoRefresh.desc: Refresh account tokens on a schedule so they do not expire.

batch.title: Batch concurrency
batch.desc: Login concurrency when adding accounts in bulk. Higher values are more likely to trigger upstream rate limits.
batch.label: Concurrency (1-20)
batch.hint: Recommended range: 1-20. Higher concurrency is more likely to trigger upstream rate limits or local network jitter.

reasoning.enable: Enable legacy mode (merge reasoning into content)
reasoning.hint: Reasoning is returned inside content with <think> tags instead of a separate reasoning_content field.

retry.desc: Retry policy for network errors; requests that received an HTTP response (including 5xx) are not retried.
